name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - Après le § 37 - Am 18
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 44a. Welcomes the Commission’s initiative for a risk-based approach to screening potential beneficiaries of Union funds for security risks and incompatibility with Union values; calls for adequate due diligence obligations on the recipients of Union funds and invites the Commission to consider the use of a ‘tiered risk hierarchy’ so that the system will not deter legitimate applicants;
